title: [29.x]-Validation of the "No." field on the sales order additionally re-validates the Unit of Measure Code
summary: Fixed a bug where validating the "No." field on a sales order with a linked released production order caused repeated production order status warnings and potential modal dialog errors in write transactions.
key_points: Validate("Unit of Measure Code") inside ValidateUnitOfMeasureCodeFromNo is now wrapped with StatusCheckSuspended to stop nested status checks
Quantity and Shipment Date validations check StatusCheckSuspended before calling CheckReceiptOrderStatus
Check Prod. Order Status also respects the suspended flag, so the warning shows only once when "No." validation starts
Prevents the 'Form.RunModal is not allowed in write transactions' error
Sales Line changed in the W1 layer and several country layers, with new tests in SCM Planning and Manufacturing
